title: Reduction output length
statement: For every finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, every natural number $c_0$, and every input bit string $x$, the reduction output has length exactly $2N^2+2N+7$, where $N$ is the number of vertices used by the reduction on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
